t: Din hammotzi rosho verubbo mereshut lirshut
s: Din hammotzi rosho verubbo mereshut lirshut ubo d' seipim: omed adam birshut hayyachid umotzi yado lirshut harabbim umetaltel sham chapatzim, shennotelan mikkan umannichan kan, veen chosheshin shemma yishkach vibiem elayv lirshut hayyachid, ubilbad shello yaabirem d' ammot birshut harabbim. Veap al pi shehu omed bemaqom echad birshut hayyachid, raq shebbeyado molik hachepetz d' ammot mimmaqom shehaya munnach — chayyab. Veken omed adam birshut harabbim umetaltel chapatzim birshut hayyachid, veen chosheshim shemma yebiem etzlo:

Bammeh debarim amurim sheen chosheshim lekak? Keshehem chapatzim sheenam tzerikim lo birshut shehu omed bah, ella birshut shemmetaltel bah bilbad, kegon sheomed birshut zo uposhet yado lirshut hashsheniyya venotel sham mapteach upoteach bo sham, sheen hammapteach tzarik lo kan birshut sheomed bah, ella sham bilbad, birshut shehu poteach bah. Veken kol kayyotze bo mishshear chapatzim sheenam tzerikim lo kan ella sham. Abal lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid veyotzi rosho lirshut harabbim veyishteh sham o lehepek, ella im ken hiknis rosho verubbo lemaqom shehu shoteh, shekkevan shehu tzarik leellu hammayim — yesh lachush shemma yishkach vibiem elayv. Veken bekol kayyotze bazeh. Abal muttar laamod birshut hayyachid o birshut harabbim velishtot bekarmelit o lehepek, shello gazeru gezera ligzera. (Veap al pi sheoqer hammayim mereshut zo veshoteh otam veniknasim lemeayv shehem birshut zo, vesham naaset hannachatan, venimtza motzi mereshut lirshut — en bekak kelum, kevan shekkebar nachu hammayim meat bepiv qodem shenniknesu lemeayv, upiv hu meqom petur, kevan shehu omed birshut zo upiv hu birshut haacheret, ukemo shennitbaer besimman shm"z sheyyesh soberim ken. Velo aseru lehaknis mikkarmelit lirshut hayyachid apillu derek meqom petur, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"v, ella mishshum gezera shemma yabo lehaknis kak beli hannacha benetayim bimqom petur, kemo shennitbaer sham, abal kan lo shayyak ligzor kelal, shei epshar kelal shello yanuchu hammayim meat bepiv terem sheyyiblaem. Veap im timtze lomar sheppiv eno meqom petur ella hu keotah reshut shehotzio (masham) [lesham], kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"z sheyyesh soberim ken, venimtza shennachu hammayim beotah reshut, ukeshebboleam umaknisam lemeayv shebbirshut acheret hare hu motzi mereshut lirshut — mikkol maqom yesh lomar shebbeliat hammayim zo hi hannachatan legamre, veen lachush kelal mah sheshshub niknasim lemeayv, lepi shekkevan shennibleu begupo — hare hem betelim legabbe gupo):

Lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid veyashtin o yaroq lirshut harabbim o lehepek, veim hishtin o raq — chayyab. Veim hotzi ammato lachutz vehishtin sham — hare zeh sapeq im holekim achar aqirat hamme raglayim mechalal shel gup birshut hayyachid, venimtza shehotzi mereshut hayyachid vechayyab, o achar yetziatam min haamma, shehu birshut harabbim upatur. Vesapeq shel tora lehachamir, vaapillu mereshut hayyachid o mereshut harabbim lekarmelit o lehepek asur. Veken im hotzi rosho lachutz veraq sham — hare zeh sapeq, veasur apillu mereshut hayyachid o mereshut harabbim lekarmelit o lehepek. Veap sheharoq nach meat bepayv qodem sheraqaq, veyesh omerim sheppiv shebbirshut haacheret hu meqom petur, mikkol maqom en zo chashuba hannacha bimqom petur, hoil velo hunnach sham mimmaqom acher achare shehotzio lirshut haacheret, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"z:

Roq shennitlash mippiv umukan lezorqo — yesh mi sheomer shello yehallek bo d' ammot birshut harabbim ad sheyyaroq, vehu haddin bekarmelit. Umikkol maqom en limchot beyad hammeqillin bekarmelit, ki yesh mattirim apillu birshut harabbim:
